## Core Student Projects
- Aksa: Adaptive Kinesthetic Learning Platform (Next.js, TypeScript, MediaPipe Vision, Supabase) — Touch-free educational platform using computer vision and voice AI. URL: https://aksa.kasuma.id
- TaruPramana: Botanical Recommendation Engine (React, Express.js, OpenAI API, Tailwind CSS) — Normalized digital database translating Balinese lontar herbal remedies. Won Best Capstone Project at Coding Camp 2026. URL: https://www.tarupramana.web.id
- Renty: Property Management & SaaS (Laravel, MySQL, Midtrans API, Tailwind CSS, React) — Multi-tenant rental management and automated financial ledger platform. URL: https://renty.kasuma.id
- Rare Angon: The Sky Runner (JavaScript, TensorFlow.js, HTML5 Canvas) — Hand-gesture controlled arcade game celebrating Balinese kite culture. URL: https://rareangon.kasuma.id
